# Elitez Events

> Singapore corporate events agency — dinner & dance, awards ceremonies, family days, conferences and Rallies™. Trusted by DSTA, SingHealth, Mandai and 60+ clients. Operated by Elitez Group of Companies.

## What it is
- Full-service corporate events agency: D&D, awards nights, family days, conferences and large-format Rallies™.
- End-to-end production — concept, staging, manpower and on-site delivery — for government and enterprise clients in Singapore.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://events.elitez.asia/): event types and approach.
- [Services](https://events.elitez.asia/pages/services.html): D&D, awards, family days, conferences.
- [Portfolio](https://events.elitez.asia/pages/portfolio.html): past events and clients.
- [Rallies](https://events.elitez.asia/pages/rallies.html): large-format corporate rallies.
- [Contact](https://events.elitez.asia/pages/contact.html): enquire.

## Operator
- Elitez Group of Companies (Singapore). Contact: events@elitez.asia.
